acceptance.note: The contract this branch first measured against (a-ccd85db0e5f2) required `line_mappings len_gt 7` on a function decompiled under `--define-function 0x140001000-0x140001043`, an extent that cuts the function's own flow at 0x140001041. Once the frame index folds to a constant the eight register-save stores are unread locals and are removed, so that clause could not be met by any correct fix; it was replaced by the captain in round 12 with the degradation guard above, and all four clauses now pass.

decisions: The filed hypothesis (callee preservation loses RAX) is UPHELD; the round-5 refutation's MECHANISM is overturned. It read `MOV R11,qword ptr GS:[0x10]` as a CALLOTHER that makes the callee-body walk incomplete. x86-64 SLEIGH lowers a segment override to `GS_OFFSET + disp` (ia.sinc:1117 and 1143), not to the `segment` userop, and the walk was measured complete at 19 instructions with proves_untouched(RAX) true.

The real blocker is calleepreserves' positive-evidence gate body_departs_from_convention: it requires a write to a register the model marks <unaffected>, and __chkstk writes only RSP/R10/R11, which x86-64-win.cspec names in neither list.
Shipped as a separate option rather than a relaxation of calleepreserves so the two evidence clauses stay independently ablatable, matching how calleeretpreserves was split out.

The anti-vacuity mark is the callee's own memory write (its save slot), not an instruction-count threshold: `ret`, `endbr64; ret`, a placeholder and a wrong-address decode all store nothing, which is exactly the set the shipped gate exists to reject.

The removal of the clipped function's frame stores was traced to RuleEarlyRemoval (ruleaction_1.rs:129), not to ActionDeadCode: it destroys any op whose output has no descendants unless the Varnode is `is_auto_live`, and a stack COPY reaching only an artificial-halt RETURN has neither. Marking the stack Varnodes `addrforce` inside ActionDeadCode does not survive -- funcdata_spacebase's symbol sync mass-clears addrtied/addrforce (funcdata_spacebase.rs:1405) between the two. A prototype guard in RuleEarlyRemoval keyed on `flow left the declared extent` does restore all eight stores and both parameters, but it also keeps the CALL's return-address slot (`v23 = 0x140001016;`) and eight unused register declarations, and it is a second defect -- a declared extent that cuts flow makes the region's memory writes look like nothing happened -- not this one. Left out of this PR; worth its own need.
